summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing unaudited first-half 2026 financial results and operational updates for its OwlPay platform and OwlPay Harbor stablecoin payment infrastructure. The filing discloses cumulative processed payment volume surpassing $700 million, annualized Harbor volume of approximately $160 million, and a target to exceed $1 billion by year-end 2026. It also notes regulatory expansion across U.S. states and international licenses. No M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is mentioned. The filing is a routine earnings release and commercial update, not a special-situation event. What to watch: continued Harbor volume growth and achievement of the $1 billion target.
